description: Get one wishlist request by slug (the last part of https://grokbot.tools/requests/{slug}): status, on-site votes, the labeled seed signal, description, public sources (links to the posts it came from), the linked connector if one exists, the builder if it has been claimed, and a matching setup guide when there is one. Slugs of requests that were merged resolve to the surviving request. Read-only.

slug.description: Request slug, e.g. 'whatsapp'. Find slugs with list_requests.

name: get_request
title: Get one wishlist request
